method: Built-in Imagegen, one independent state per call, grounded in the approved installation screenshot. Discord state received a targeted correction to keep future steps neutral. Final generated PNGs copied without pixel changes or resizing.
approval_scope: Koka approved the single-block installation frame and asked for the other stages with a changing title, especially waiting for access. These six new images illustrate that request and have not received a separate subsequent approval.
mock_data: All profiles, server occupancy, statuses and glyphs are fictional; no real account, code, session or admission is verified. 12/20 means simultaneous occupancy, not a community-member limit.
sga_implementation_note: The glyph example is a visual sample, not an encoded valid admission string. Use the actual SGA font and existing player code when implementing the authenticated optional view.
